## Fixed
- **Fixed services staying "unknown" forever after a canary false alarm**: if the connectivity canaries were blocked or unreachable (e.g. ad blockers/DNS filtering of the 204 endpoints, firewall rules), the integration could get stuck reporting everything as `unknown`. Hosts are now re-checked with a single attempt every cycle, and a single successful host check overrules a misleading canary — the integration self-heals.
- Canary checks are more robust now: a second DNS-independent TCP check (`8.8.8.8:443`) was added alongside `1.1.1.1:443` and the HTTP 204 endpoints.

## Changed
- During an internet outage, monitored hosts are checked with a single attempt per cycle instead of being skipped entirely (fast recovery detection, no retries burned).
